name: model_op_causal_conv1d_fn
description: Varlen causal depthwise conv1d with continuous batching (FlagGems-vllm PR #724, causal_conv1d_fn). x [dim, cu_seq_len] float16/bfloat16/float32 holds the batch's sequences concatenated left to right; weight [dim, width]; optional bias [dim]; conv_states [num_slots, dim, width-1] is the KV-style conv state cache; query_start_loc [batch+1] int32 gives cumulative sequence starts prefixed by 0; cache_indices [batch] int32 selects the conv_states slot per sequence, with pad_slot_id marking padded entries that must be skipped entirely; has_initial_state [batch] bool selects whether a sequence seeds from its cached state. Each sequence is convolved causally over width taps, activation 'silu' (or None) is applied, and the trailing width-1 inputs are written back into conv_states[cache_indices[i]] in place. Returns the output [dim, cu_seq_len]; conv_states is mutated in place.
